name: High-Speed Toy DC Motor
description: Like an electric fan propeller! Spins continuously when power is applied, controllable via H-Bridge.
realWorldAnalogy: Like an electric fan propeller! Spins continuously when power is applied, controllable via H-Bridge.
wiringGuidance: Connect motor terminals through a transistor (e.g. PN2222) or motor driver shield. Never connect motor leads directly to Arduino pins!
commonMistakes: Connecting DC motor directly to Arduino pins (exceeds 40mA max pin rating and fries the board).
Omitting the flyback protection diode across the motor terminals.

miniExperiment.title: Transistor Motor Speed Control
miniExperiment.circuit: Arduino Pin 9 -> 1k resistor -> Base of NPN transistor. Collector -> Motor -> 5V. Emitter -> GND. Diode across motor.
miniExperiment.expectedOutput: Motor smoothly spins up from zero to full speed, stops, and repeats.
